name: initHydra
description: Starts Hydra (Icing, right of this Filo, draws it) and makes Hydra's functions, outputs and values global for the rest of this evaluate: `noise`, `shape`, `speed`, `hush`, `time` and `src` are Hydra's then. The next evaluate starts with Strudel's names again; one without `initHydra()` hushes the visuals. Its options are ignored.

name: loadScript
description: Runs a Hydra extension (https only, cached like samples) in global scope, so its `setFunction()`s join Hydra's functions. Starts Hydra as `initHydra()` does. A failed fetch or script fails the evaluate.

name: H
description: A pattern as a Hydra argument: its value at the cycle Filo plays.

name: midin
description: Filo's MIDI input: the device chosen in Filo's menu (`input` only names it). Resolves to `cc(ccNum, chan)`: a pattern of CC `ccNum`'s latest value / 127 (0..1), 0 until one arrives; on MIDI channel `chan` (1-16) only, if given.
examples:
let cc = await midin('My controller')
note("c2 eb2 g2").s("sawtooth").lpf(cc(74).range(200, 4000))

name: a
description: Hydra's audio analysis of Icing's AUDIO input (unpatched: Filo's L+R): `a.fft[i]` per bin; `a.setBins`, `a.setSmooth`, `a.setCutoff`, `a.setScale`.

name: fft
description: Hydra audio: bin `i`'s level of the AUDIO input, 0 at the cutoff, 1 at cutoff + scale.

name: setBins
description: Hydra audio: the number of bins in `a.fft` (also `a0`, `a1`, ... as functions).

name: setSmooth
description: Hydra audio: how much each bin keeps of its previous value (0..1).

name: setCutoff
description: Hydra audio: the level below which a bin reads 0.

name: setScale
description: Hydra audio: the level above the cutoff that reads 1.
